🎥🎬: Girls Trip (2017)

Four lifelong friends known as the Flossy Posse have drifted apart as careers, relationships, and responsibilities take over their lives. When successful author Ryan Pierce invites her best friends to join her at the Essence Festival in New Orleans, the reunion promises to be the perfect opportunity to reconnect and revive their sisterhood.

But once the ladies hit the city, things quickly spiral into wild parties, outrageous adventures, messy confessions, and hilarious situations that test their friendship. From Ryan’s carefully managed public image to Sasha’s career struggles, Lisa’s overprotective nature, and Dina’s unapologetically chaotic personality, everyone has something to confront.

Beneath all the laughter and madness, the trip forces the women to face uncomfortable truths about loyalty, ambition, and what it really means to have each other’s backs. Sometimes, the best therapy is a trip with your girls—and absolutely no filter.

source_details.synopsis: Girls Trip is a 2017 American comedy film starring Regina Hall, Tiffany Haddish, Jada Pinkett Smith and Queen Latifah. The film is directed by Malcolm D. Lee and written by Kenya Barris and Tracy Oliver, from a story by the pair and Erica Rivinoja, who based the script off their own experiences with their female friends. The film follows a group of four friends who go to New Orleans to attend the Essence Music Festival in order to reconnect after a long time. The film premiered in June 2017 and received multiple awards and nominations, most notably at the 49th NAACP Image Awards, with Haddish's performance receiving critical acclaim.
